11.t: Working with data: ramp height and speed
q: What was the speed when the ramp was 20 cm high?
By how much did the speed increase from 5 cm to 30 cm?
Describe the pattern. Is speed proportional to height?
Speed increases with height, but more slowly at greater heights; it is not proportional (6 times the height gives under 3 times the speed).
Predict the speed at 40 cm and explain one reason why the measured speeds might be lower than expected.
About 2.4 m per s (following the curve). Lower because of friction and air resistance, and reaction time when timing.
